title: Finite ordered Postnikov towers for an arbitrary t-structure
statement:
Let $\mathcal U$ be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] with a t-structure $t$ [def-weil-t-structure], heart $\mathcal H=\mathcal U^{\le0}\cap\mathcal U^{\ge0}$ and truncation functors $\tau^{\le q},\tau^{\ge q}$, which exist for every t-structure, bounded or not, together with the truncation triangles $\tau^{\le q}K\to K\to\tau^{\ge q+1}K\to\tau^{\le q}K[1]$, unique up to unique isomorphism [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles]. Write $H_t^q(K)=(\tau^{\ge q}\tau^{\le q}K)[q]\in\mathcal H$, regarded as an object of $\mathcal U$. For $a\in\mathbf Z$, $n\in\mathbf N$ and $K\in\mathcal U^{\ge a}\cap\mathcal U^{\le a+n-1}$, there exist objects $L_0,\ldots,L_n$ and distinguished triangles
$$L_j\longrightarrow L_{j+1}\longrightarrow H_t^{a+j}(K)[-a-j]\longrightarrow L_j[1]\qquad(0\le j<n),$$
with $L_0\cong0$, $L_n\cong K$ and $L_j\cong\tau^{\le a+j-1}K$ for every $0\le j\le n$. Thus the factors are the cohomology objects of this very $K$, in increasing degree, and there are exactly $n$ extension steps. For $n=0$ the assertion includes $K\cong0$ and no triangles. The t-structure need not be bounded or nondegenerate on all of $\mathcal U$; the actual t-bounds on $K$ are required. When $\mathcal U=D(\mathcal C)$ for an abelian category $\mathcal C$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with its standard t-structure [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], $H_t^q(K)\cong H^q(K)[0]$, so the displayed factors are $H^{a+j}(K)[0][-a-j]$.

source.place: Propositions 1.3.3 and 1.3.5, Theorem 1.3.6 and its derived-category example, pp. 29-32 (PDF pp. 30-33); finite ordered triangles as in 1.3.13, pp. 34-35. Derived-category specialization: Stacks derived.tex, Tag 08J5 (remark-truncation-distinguished-triangle).
